description:
We are a team passionate about science, technology, innovation, and environmental sustainability. Our goal is to develop creative solutions using NASA data to help farmers adapt to changing climate conditions and improve crop productivity.

We are interested in Earth science, data analysis, software development, and multimedia communication. We value teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving, and we are eager to learn from each other while building a meaningful solution.✌🏻
summary:
Chakra Muyuy: Smart Agriculture Powered by NASA Satellite Data

Chakra Muyuy is a smart agriculture platform that transforms NASA satellite data into practical insights to help farmers make better irrigation decisions. Using NASA's SMAP soil moisture observations and Earthdata services, our solution analyzes surface and root-zone soil moisture through a specialized Water Engine, converting complex scientific datasets into accessible agricultural information. By addressing the lack of affordable soil monitoring technologies, Chakra Muyuy enables farmers to understand soil moisture conditions without installing expensive physical sensors. Our platform aims to reduce water waste, improve irrigation efficiency, support crop productivity, and strengthen agricultural resilience to climate change and water scarcity. By connecting space technology with everyday farming needs, Chakra Muyuy empowers small-scale farmers and rural communities with accessible environmental intelligence. **Our vision is to make every drop count and build a smarter, more sustainable future for agriculture.
details:
CHAKRA MUYUY: FROM SPACE TO SOIL, INTELLIGENCE TO CULTIVATE THE FUTURE 🌱🛰️

What if farmers could understand what is happening beneath their crops before water scarcity threatens their harvest? Chakra Muyuy was born to make this possible, bringing smarter, more sustainable, and future-ready agriculture within everyone's reach. We are an innovative smart agriculture platform that connects NASA's space technology with the real needs of farmers, transforming satellite data into clear, practical, and actionable insights for those who feed the world. By leveraging NASA's Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) satellite data through NASA Earthdata services, our platform analyzes surface and root-zone soil moisture conditions, turning complex scientific observations into valuable information that helps farmers understand when their crops may need water and make smarter irrigation decisions. Powered by HDF5 data processing, backend APIs, and our specialized Water Engine, Chakra Muyuy brings advanced satellite-based intelligence directly to agricultural communities without requiring expensive physical soil sensors. Our mission is to help farmers make every drop of water count, reduce unnecessary water consumption, improve irrigation efficiency, and strengthen crop productivity in the face of climate change and increasing water scarcity. We believe innovation should not be a privilege reserved for those who can afford expensive technologies; it should be accessible to small-scale farmers and rural communities whose work sustains the world. That is why Chakra Muyuy is designed as an accessible, scalable, and adaptable solution for different agricultural regions, recognizing local conditions and the limitations of satellite observations. Because farming should not depend on intuition alone, but also on knowledge, technology, and better decisions. Chakra Muyuy: Bringing the intelligence of space down to Earth, making every drop count, every crop matter, and every harvest part of a more sustainable future.
